diagnostics.message: The null_resource 'update_app' reconfigures the GitHub App to deliver webhooks to the API Gateway endpoint (module.multi-runner.webhook.endpoint). Its only ordering comes from the webhook output, which resolves to the aws_apigatewayv2_api object (plus the webhook lambda, log group, and role). It has no dependency on the aws_apigatewayv2_stage ('$default', auto_deploy) — nor on the aws_apigatewayv2_route/integration behind it — so Terraform may run the update-app.sh local-exec while the stage that makes the endpoint serve traffic is still being created, briefly pointing the GitHub App webhook at a non-functional URL. Add a depends_on for the webhook stage so the endpoint is deployed before the GitHub App is updated.
